title: Rewinding the Comparator Heads
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, every input-head position $p$ among its $|x|+2$ allowed positions, four Boolean words $w_0,w_1,w_2,w_3$, and Boolean verdict $b$, let $m$ be the maximum of their lengths. For each natural number $j\le m$, starting the comparator in its rewinding control with all four work-head positions at $j-1$ and running it for $j+1$ steps yields the configuration with completed control carrying $b$, all four heads at zero, the same words on the tapes, the same input-head position, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: natural number j at most the maximum word length
replaced: For every input word, input position, four words, stored verdict, and count $j$ at most the common width, running the comparator in its rewind control at aligned position $j-1$ for $j+1$ steps returns all four heads to zero and enters the completed control, preserving every word and the verdict.
